title: S04T04 - Implement scoped merge prepare, apply, resume, rollback, and cleanup
description: Plan and execute reviewed merges with scope guards, preflight checks, resumable state, rollback protection, and worktree/branch cleanup only after verified success.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge preparation identifies target/base/head SHAs, expected commits, changed paths, validation gates, and out-of-scope changes before mutation.
Interrupted or conflicted merges can resume or roll back without losing source branches, reviews, evidence, or work records.
Worktrees and branches are removed only after merge and post-merge verification succeed.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
